name: Catan
tagline: Settle, trade, and build your way to victory
description: Catan (formerly Settlers of Catan) is a multiplayer strategy game where players collect resources, build settlements, and trade to expand across a modular island. Every game features a different board layout, ensuring high replayability.

guide.objective: Be the first player to earn 10 Victory Points by building settlements, cities, roads, and special cards.
quickRules: Roll dice to produce resources on matching hex numbers
Collect wood, brick, grain, ore, and wool resources
Build roads, settlements, and cities using resource cards
Trade with other players or the bank (4:1 or port rates)

sections.title: Setting Up the Island
sections.content: The island of Catan is built fresh each game by randomly arranging hex terrain tiles and number tokens.

diagram.caption: The island of Catan — 19 resource hexes surrounded by ocean tiles

steps.title: Assemble the frame
steps.description: Place the 6 ocean border pieces to form the island frame.

steps.title: Place terrain hexes
steps.description: Randomly place all 19 terrain hexes inside the frame: 4 forests, 4 pastures, 4 fields, 3 mountains, 3 hills, 1 desert.

steps.title: Assign number tokens
steps.description: Place the lettered number tokens (2–12, except 7) on non-desert hexes in alphabetical spiral order starting from a corner.
steps.tip: The red numbers 6 and 8 cannot be adjacent to each other — they are most frequently rolled.

steps.title: Place the robber
steps.description: Place the robber pawn on the desert hex.

steps.title: Place starting settlements
steps.description: In reverse turn order, each player places 2 settlements and 2 roads. The last player places both sets before reversing. Each player takes resources matching the hexes touching their second settlement.

sections.title: Resources
sections.content: There are 5 resource types. Every building and development card costs specific combinations of resources.

rules.title: Wood (Forest)
rules.description: Produced by forest hexes. Used to build roads and settlements.

rules.title: Brick (Hills)
rules.description: Produced by hills hexes. Used to build roads and settlements.

rules.title: Grain (Fields)
rules.description: Produced by fields hexes. Used to build settlements, upgrade to cities, and buy development cards.

rules.title: Ore (Mountains)
rules.description: Produced by mountain hexes. Used to upgrade settlements to cities and buy development cards.

rules.title: Wool (Pasture)
rules.description: Produced by pasture hexes. Used to build settlements and buy development cards.

steps.title: Roll the dice
steps.description: Roll both dice. All players collect resources from hexes touching settlements or cities that match the rolled number. Cities collect 2 resources; settlements collect 1.
steps.tip: If a 7 is rolled, players with more than 7 cards must discard half. Then the active player moves the robber.

steps.title: Trade
steps.description: Trade resource cards with other players at any ratio you both agree on. Or trade with the bank at 4:1 (or 3:1 / 2:1 at ports).

steps.title: Build
steps.description: Spend resources to build: Road (1 wood + 1 brick), Settlement (1 wood + 1 brick + 1 grain + 1 wool), City upgrade (2 grain + 3 ore), Development card (1 grain + 1 ore + 1 wool).

rules.title: Settlements
rules.description: Each settlement is worth 1 Victory Point.

rules.title: Cities
rules.description: Each city (upgraded settlement) is worth 2 Victory Points.

rules.title: Longest Road
rules.description: The player with the longest continuous road of 5+ segments earns the Longest Road card (2 VP). Can be stolen.

rules.title: Largest Army
rules.description: The player who plays the most Knight development cards (3+) earns the Largest Army card (2 VP). Can be stolen.

rules.title: Victory Point Development Cards
rules.description: Some development cards are worth 1 VP each. Reveal them all at once when you reach 10 VP.

variants.name: Catan: 5–6 Player Extension
variants.description: An expansion that extends the game for up to 6 players with additional hexes, cards, and pieces.

variants.name: Seafarers
variants.description: An expansion adding ships, gold hexes, and multiple islands to explore and colonize.

tips.title: Diversify your resources
tips.content: Try to place your starting settlements so you can produce at least 3 different resource types. Having access to all 5 from the start is ideal.

tips.title: Build toward ports
tips.content: A 2:1 port for a resource you produce abundantly lets you trade very efficiently. Planning road routes toward ports is often a winning strategy.

tips.title: Trade generously early
tips.content: Trading keeps the game flowing and builds goodwill. Early in the game, be open to trades — you'll need help later too.
